request.prompt:
Goods: Centrifugal water pump 1.1kW
Country of origin: CN

Chosen so far: 84 Machinery and mechanical appliances, boilers, nuclear reactors; parts thereof > 8413 Pumps; for liquids, whether or not fitted with measuring device, liquid elevators

Choose the subheading that covers these goods. Options:
- 841370: Pumps; centrifugal, n.e.c. in heading no. 8413, for liquids
- 841360: Pumps; rotary positive displacement pumps, n.e.c. in heading no. 8413, for liquids
- 841340: Pumps; concrete pumps
- 841319: Pumps; for liquids, fitted or designed to be fitted with a measuring device, other than pumps for dispensing fuel or lubricants
- 841350: Pumps; reciprocating positive displacement pumps, n.e.c. in heading no. 8413, for liquids
- 841330: Pumps; fuel, lubricating or cooling medium pumps for internal combustion piston engines

Answer "none" if no option can cover these goods.

data.reason: A centrifugal water pump with no measuring device and not a fuel, lubricant or cooling pump for engines falls under the centrifugal pumps subheading, 8413.70.
